title: June: Packing Up and Moving On
coreMove: Enough becomes real when life is light enough to move. Fewer things and lower needs make space for honest ties, portable work, and room to choose.

exampleSpecs.audience: a salaried worker preparing to leave
exampleSpecs.stakes: Financial preparation can steady the leap without pretending self-employment is risk-free.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show excitement and fear sharing the same self-employment calculation.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A healthy exit can include grief, gratitude, and practical care for the team left behind.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Keep the boss as mentor and friend while the resignation proceeds.

exampleSpecs.audience: an employee documenting a role before departure
exampleSpecs.stakes: The exit either becomes a clean handoff or leaves the next person to inherit hidden work.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use training replacement and documented responsibilities as the evidence of a responsible resignation.

exampleSpecs.audience: a city worker with portable clients
exampleSpecs.stakes: Portable work makes place a values choice rather than a status reflex.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Make family, friends, community, and nature outweigh the old city script.

exampleSpecs.audience: a renter packing after a year of decluttering
exampleSpecs.stakes: The smaller pile makes internal change visible without pretending boxes are the whole story.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use 30 percent, boxes, moving, and belongings as the physical proof of a lighter life.

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader replacing old coping habits
exampleSpecs.stakes: A shopping ban and decluttering must work together or the old identity refills the space.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show not buying revealing needs while letting go removes old identity weight.
